Two soil components reching for equilibrium.
  < equilibrium (equilibrium equilibrium )
                    (k AB k AB )
                    (k BA k BA ) >

    equilibrium: equilibrium component (see chapter 39)
     Function for calculating equilibrium between A and B.
    k AB : number component (see chapter 59)
     Tranformation rate from soil component ’A’ to ’B’ [h−1 ].

    k BA: number component (see chapter 59)
     Optional component
     Tranformation rate from soil component ’B’ to ’A’ [h−1 ]. By default, this is
     identical to ’k AB’.
